objective: Sincronizar exclusivamente el detalle ISCAM canonico de 130MID para todo marzo 2026, sin tocar encabezados. Procesar 2026-03-01 a 2026-04-01 fin exclusivo; escribir solo dias que concilien contra Runtime V2 y certificar cobertura y deltas por SQL. Etiqueta: Sincronizador | 130MID | Marzo 2026 | Detalle.

queries.name: 130mid_mar2026_runtime_coverage
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT fecha_operacion) AS dias_runtime,
    MIN(fecha_operacion) AS fecha_min,
    MAX(fecha_operacion) AS fecha_max
FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
  AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-03-01'
  AND fecha_operacion < '2026-04-01'

queries.name: 130mid_mar2026_detail_coverage
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT fecha_operacion) AS dias_con_detalle,
    COUNT(DISTINCT numero_ticket) AS tickets,
    COUNT(*) AS lineas,
    MIN(fecha_operacion) AS fecha_min,
    MAX(fecha_operacion) AS fecha_max,
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(importe_neto,0)),2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe_detalle
FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
  AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-03-01'
  AND fecha_operacion < '2026-04-01'
  AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1

queries.name: 130mid_mar2026_detail_mismatches
queries.sql:
WITH detalle_ticket AS (
    SELECT
        fecha_operacion,
        numero_ticket,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS ventas_ticket,
        MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_ticket
    FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
    WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
      AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-03-01'
      AND fecha_operacion < '2026-04-01'
      AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1
      AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
    GROUP BY fecha_operacion, numero_ticket
),
detalle_dia AS (
    SELECT
        fecha_operacion,
        SUM(ventas_ticket) AS ventas_detalle,
        COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle,
        SUM(pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle
    FROM detalle_ticket
    GROUP BY fecha_operacion
),
runtime_dia AS (
    SELECT
        fecha_operacion,
        SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS ventas_runtime,
        SUM(ISNULL(tickets_total,0)) AS tickets_runtime,
        SUM(ISNULL(pax_total,0)) AS pax_runtime
    FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
    WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
      AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-03-01'
      AND fecha_operacion < '2026-04-01'
    GROUP BY fecha_operacion
)
SELECT
    r.fecha_operacion,
    r.ventas_runtime,
    ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0) AS ventas_detalle,
    CAST(ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0)-r.ventas_runtime AS decimal(18,4)) AS delta_ventas,
    r.tickets_runtime,
    ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) AS tickets_detalle,
    ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0)-r.tickets_runtime AS delta_tickets,
    r.pax_runtime,
    ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) AS pax_detalle,
    ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0)-r.pax_runtime AS delta_pax
FROM runtime_dia r
LEFT JOIN detalle_dia d
  ON d.fecha_operacion=r.fecha_operacion
WHERE ABS(ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0)-r.ventas_runtime) > 0.01
   OR ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) <> r.tickets_runtime
   OR ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) <> r.pax_runtime
ORDER BY r.fecha_operacion

constraints: Detalle-only: no modificar Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 ni encabezados
No tocar Produccion de codigo; solo datos canonicos autorizados en EDARSAHUB
